title: Optimization design of flow channel depth-to-width ratio for anion exchange membrane water electrolyzers based on entropy weight method and multi-physics coupling
scope: 3D coupled AEM equation reconstruction with declared closures; not an exact reproduction of the COMSOL model

estimated_or_interpreted_inputs.koh_conductivity_scale: Default 1: printed Eq32 as S/m; alternative 100 for customary S/cm materially changes predictions and failed the tested temperature bound. Authors intent unresolved.
estimated_or_interpreted_inputs.energy: Default COMSOL-style LTE phase-fluid advection. Printed solid/fluid-capacity expression retained as a diagnostic only.
estimated_or_interpreted_inputs.channel_slip: Zero advective slip; no drag/slip closure supplied
estimated_or_interpreted_inputs.channel_dispersion: Unreported effective phase dispersion; not a measured/recovered paper value
estimated_or_interpreted_inputs.gas_species: Pure phase inventories with channel counter-dispersion; no dissolved species or concentration-overpotential feedback
estimated_or_interpreted_inputs.surface_averages: Volume averages except area-average inlet pressure
estimated_or_interpreted_inputs.whole_cell_temperature_gradient: Volume mean magnitude; reduction not specified in paper
estimated_or_interpreted_inputs.bp: 2 mm total, channel cut into BP

numerical.linear_solver: Row-equilibrated BiCGStab/ILUT with verified residual and SparseLU fallback; direct option available for cross-checks
numerical.mesh_policy: An explicit warning is retained for orthogonal CL aspect ratios <= 1400. All other checks must pass; flagged cell membership and physical dimensions are independently checked.

optimization: EWM panels plus frozen-calibration optimization. Qualified baseline required; --problem all skips uncalibrated P008. No claim of the published optimum.
limitations: Current predictions are sensitive to catalyst-layer resolution; mesh independence has not been established.
Baseline current differs from the paper; parameter/equation ambiguities unresolved.
No VOF bubble dynamics, vapor or dissolved multicomponent transport.
Passed baseline is neither mesh independence nor paper validation.

commands.checker: flowfield-check run --problem P008 --study mesh numerics --backend native --timeout 14400 --output runs/check-p008-001
